text:
Alex: PagerDuty alert PD-10123: elevated 5xx and timeouts on /api/generate in prod-north. Triggering oncall.
PagerDuty: [ALERT] PD-10123 fired for service inference-gateway (severity: page).
Alex: Jumping into dashboards: https://obs.redwood.internal/d/5xx-overview?range=10m
Alex: 5xx rate jumped from 0.3% to 9.6% at 2026-03-16T02:03:12Z, p95 latency from 180ms to 1.2s.
Nina: I see retry counters on the loadbalancer spiking (upstream_rq_retry_total). Also host selection skewed: traffic now 88% -> shard-2.
Ravi: That matches a route rollout earlier: `route-change/2026-03-16T01:58` PR #4201 moved traffic to shard-2 for latency experiment.
Chen: If shard-2 had a bad instance set, retries will multiply requests and push it over the edge. Do we have recent kernel or docker restarts?
Nina: Node metrics show queue length and CPU bursts on shard-2 nodes starting 01:59. Envoy stats: `upstream_rq_5xx` rising and `upstream_rq_timeout` too.
Alex: Emergency mitigation options: 1) disable route retries, 2) add stricter circuit-breaker to route, 3) rollback route weights. Which to apply first?
Ravi: Fastest: disable retries at LB layer; that prevents amplification instantly. Then canary rollback of weight.
Chen: Agree. I'll prepare a hotpatch. Using playbook: `lbctl apply-patch --cluster prod-north --route /api/generate --patch-from-stdin`
Chen: Proposed patch snippet:
```
retry_policy:
  retry_on: "none"
  num_retries: 0
circuit_breakers:
  thresholds:
    - max_pending_requests: 150
      max_connections: 2000
      max_requests: 800
      max_retries: 0
```
Ravi: Also set `max_concurrent_streams` lower to allow shedding if necessary.
InfraBot: Action required: infra-admin role to approve `lb-hotpatch-20260316-02`. Run `infra playbook run lb-hotpatch-20260316-02` to proceed.
Alex: I have infra-admin. Applying to prod-north now.
Alex: Running:
```
infra playbook run lb-hotpatch-20260316-02 --cluster prod-north --patch-file - <<EOF
(retry_policy + cb patch)
EOF
```
InfraBot: Playbook accepted, execution id hp-20260316-02, applying patch to envoy configuration.
Nina: Patch applied to prod-north. Envoy config reloaded. Watching metrics.
Alex: Dashboard: 5xx fell from 9.6% to 4.1% within 45s. Latency p95 down to 420ms.
Chen: Good partial improvement. Rolling the same hotpatch to prod-west for parity.
Ravi: Meanwhile I'm kicking off a revert PR for route weights: PR #4209 to restore previous weights. Can we canary that?
Alex: Yes, canary to 10% first.
InfraBot: Revert PR merged; canary traffic applied (10% prod-north). Monitoring canary.
Nina: Canary looks healthy at 10% -> no spike. Rolling to 100% over 3 minutes.
Nina: After full revert, 5xx back to baseline ~0.4% and p95 ~200ms.
Chen: Root cause indicators: one node in shard-2 restarted containers at 01:57 due to repeated container OOM, and model-worker logs show slow model reloads that coincide with the restart.
Ravi: That explains capacity loss. The route rollout concentrated traffic on the degraded shard causing overload; default retry_policy then retried many requests to other backends, amplifying traffic.
Alex: Customer impact: Support reports increased errors for tenants X17 and Y3. Estimated affected requests ~15% of regional traffic, error rate peaked ~9.6%. Support notified customers and created tickets #8930, #8931.
SupportBot: Tickets created and customer notifications sent with initial ETA 1h for full remediation.
OnCall-Lead: I'm on the thread. Summarize timeline and next steps please.
Alex: Timeline: 01:58 route rollout PR #4201 -> 02:03 5xx spike and pager PD-10123 -> 02:06 hotpatch disable retries (hp-20260316-02) -> 02:08 canary revert PR #4209 -> 02:11 full revert -> 02:14 metrics stabilized.
Chen: Immediate post-incident actions: collect /var/log/syslog and docker logs from shard-2 nodes (uploaded to /incident/PD-10123/logs), run memory profiling on model-worker, and look for recent image changes.
Ravi: Longer term: 1) add deploy guard to prevent >65% weight increase to single shard in one rollout, 2) make retry_policy explicit in all route configs (fail-closed), 3) add circuit-breaker lint to CI. I'll own the CI lint.
Nina: Also propose a safety: when route weight shifting causes >20% traffic skew, run health-check gating for 5 minutes before full rollout.
Alex: I'll create the incident ticket and start a postmortem doc. Assign owners: logs & model debug (Chen), CI lint & weight guard (Ravi), customer comms & writeup (Alex), metrics dashboard alert tuning (Nina).
OnCall-Lead: Good. We'll schedule a 1.5hr postmortem tomorrow and mark PD-10123 resolved once owners ack. Great work on fast rollback and hotpatch.
PagerDuty: PD-10123 resolved by user OnCall-Lead at 2026-03-16T02:25:40Z.
Alex: Closing the paging loop here; leaving thread open for postmortem notes and uploads. Thanks all. :tada:
